scenario: [LTSL.3.7]: an absolute timeline coordinate is a `calendar.time` call whose arguments fold, and a coordinate of any other form is DS_VALIDATE_TEST_BAD_TIMESTAMP. A quoted ISO-8601 stamp, `at "2026-06-18T14:00:00Z":`, is refused, offset or not: DS reads no temporal text ([LTIM.14]). PATH PINNED: `dsc.dstest.ltsl_3_1_coordinate`, whose `ltim_14_3_calendar_fold` fails on a string.
rules_ds:
schema Ping scope logical:
    id: Int key

rule seen:
    Ping p
->
    log info "seen {p.id}"

test "a quoted stamp":
    inputs:
        at "2026-06-18T14:00:00Z":
            Ping id: 1
    produces:
        activated seen
